title: Palestinian VP Accuses Israel of Mass Detention Camps in Occupied Territory at UNGA
detail: Palestinian Vice President publicly accused Israel of transforming parts of occupied Palestinian territory into mass detention camps, intensifying international rights criticism at the margins of the UN General Assembly session.

title: Israeli Drone Strike Kills Three Near School in Gaza City's Tuffah Neighborhood
detail: An Israeli combat drone struck a group of people near a cafe close to Muscat School in the al-Mashahra area of the Tuffah neighborhood, northeast Gaza City, on Tuesday, September 22, 2026, killing two instantly and wounding three others, including a child; a third victim, identified as Adham Sobhi Ziyara, later died of his wounds. Gaza's Health Ministry said Israeli fire killed five Palestinians and wounded 25 more across the Strip over the preceding 24 hours, putting the toll since the October 2025 ceasefire at 1,399 killed and 4,863 wounded. The IDF did not immediately comment on the individual strike.

title: 200+ Settlers Storm Al-Mazra'a Ash-Sharqiya; Silwad Livestock Stolen in Separate Raid
detail: Israeli settlers carried out a wave of attacks across the occupied West Bank before dawn on Tuesday, September 22, 2026. More than 200 settlers, under the protection of Israeli soldiers, attacked the outskirts of al-Mazra'a ash-Sharqiya, east of Ramallah, damaging at least four vehicles and two homes before residents forced them to withdraw. In a separate incident, dozens of settlers accompanied by a large Israeli military force stormed Silwad, northeast of Ramallah, and seized dozens of livestock belonging to three residents -- Abdul-Alim Abdullah Hammad, Ismael Afif Hammad and Ata Mahmoud Hammad -- while damaging property at several homes; Silwad Mayor Raed Hamed said the settlers entered via an unpaved agricultural road near Ayoun al-Haramiyah. Separately in Yatta, south of Hebron, colonizers assaulted women and children at the Mos'ef family home and attempted to drive sheep into the courtyard to seize the property, after which Israeli forces detained resident Rami Issa Mos'ef.
